decisions.reason: The source changes when the updated package should be sent but does not change the required style-set coverage or additions.
Packaging the results after testing and fixes does not alter the required line-break behavior.
The source does not change the editable-field mechanism, intended use, or legacy-field handling.
The updated-package request does not resolve the existing ambiguity or modify the required table-layout behavior.
The source does not change any graphic-bullet appearance requirement; it only requests a package after testing and fixes.
The package-delivery condition does not change the required legacy copy-paste behavior, test sources, target version, or unresolved workflow ambiguity.
The source does not modify or resolve the required Tab-controlled list hierarchy.
The updated final package is distinct from the earlier task-local due-diligence assessment and does not alter its required outputs or method.
The source does not change the language, coverage, text rule, or content of the interactive-field labels.
The package request does not change the required placeholder-clearing behavior.
The source does not modify any typography or style-spacing value.
The source does not change the required theme colors or their scope; inclusion in an eventual package is only incidental.
